findings.message: The slice end `start + size + 1` returns `size + 1` users per page, so each page also includes the first user of the next page and that user appears twice across pages.
findings.suggestion: return [User(r["id"], r["email"], r["name"]) for r in rows[start : start + size]]

findings.message: Every call now loads the whole `users` table into memory just to return one page. On a large table this makes paging slow and memory-hungry. The previous `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` query let SQLite return only the requested rows.
